name: Meraioth
overview: Meraioth was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified as the son of Ahitub. He is noted as an Aaronic priest through the lineage of Phinehas, son of Eliezer, indicating his role within the priestly heritage established by Aaron. His mention in 1 Chronicles 9:11 situates him within the Levitical priesthood lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Meraioth means "rebellious" in Hebrew. It is a proper name mentioned in 1 Chronicles 9:11, though it was not given by God. This name reflects the personal designation of this individual without additional titles recorded.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Meraioth was the son of Ahitub, as stated in 1 Chronicles 9:11. It is also inferred that Zadok was his father, linking him to a notable priestly family. No further family relationships are documented beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Meraioth's significance lies in his role as an Aaronic priest within the Levitical tribe, serving in the lineage of Phinehas, son of Eliezer. This connection underscores his participation in the priestly duties ordained by God for the descendants of Aaron, maintaining the sacred service in Israel. His mention in the genealogical record of 1 Chronicles highlights the continuity of priestly service across generations.
